description: Semantic snapshot of the current page: interactive elements carry [eN] refs, and iframe content is flattened in. Narrow it with rootRef (the subtree of a single element), selector, or filter:interactive (interactive elements only).

filter.description: balanced (default) keeps structure and text, interactive keeps only interactive elements, text keeps only text

selector.description: Snapshot only the subtree matching this CSS selector (main document)

name: browser_snapshot
